Hi Evelyn,

Thanks again for the demo last week. As part of our procurement and security review we need Redwood to complete the SIG questionnaire and provide an inventory of all subprocessors and third‑party vendors that may process customer data. Specifically we're looking for:

- A CSV list of subprocessors with company name, service provided, region(s) where they process data, and data categories touched (e.g., PII, telemetry, logs).
- Supporting evidence: SOC 2 reports or summaries, network/dataflow diagrams, KMS/HSM attestations or description of key handling, and any DPA/DPA contacts.
- Telemetry and monitoring vendors (e.g., tracing, metrics, logging) and whether they receive raw customer payloads or only anonymized metadata.

Can you confirm scope (hosted API only, or private deployments too?) and provide an ETA? We ideally want the SIG responses and supporting artifacts by end of day Dec 27 to keep the evaluation on schedule.

Appreciate it — happy to hop on a short call if that helps.

Regards,

Jorge —

Attached is our initial deliverable for DataRidge's SIG intake: a master CSV manifest and supporting artifacts. High level: we are providing the Hosted API scope only (as requested). If you later need Private/VPC, let us know and we'll prepare a separate export.

Attachments included (attached to this email):
- redwood_subprocessors_manifest_20261220.csv — canonical list with vendor, service, region(s), data categories, and vendor POC.
- network_dataflow_diagram_20261220.pdf — high‑level dataflow for Hosted API (what crosses our boundary, where telemetry is collected).
- kms_key_management_attestation_20261220.pdf — description and attestation of our key lifecycle with links to KMS/HSM controls.
- soc2_summary_202606.pdf — SOC 2 Type II summary and list of in‑scope controls (full report available under NDA).

Quick notes from the manifest (high‑level):
- Compute & storage: AWS (us-east-1) — EC2/ECS/S3 used for model hosting; processes customer prompt data while in flight.
- Edge & caching: CloudZone (multi‑region) — CDN & edge cache for public API assets only, does not store raw prompts.
- Telemetry & logging: Logstream Analytics (log aggregation), Sentry (error traces), and Datamon (metrics).
  - Logstream: receives aggregated logs (no raw prompt payloads); retention set to 30 days for telemetry.
  - Sentry: receives stack traces and limited snippets for error reproduction; we scrub prompt text by default.
  - Datamon: metrics only (no payloads).
- Support & tickets: Zendesk — support tickets may contain customer snippets when customers paste prompts; tickets are access controlled and retained per our retention policy.
- Pager & alerting: PagerDuty — receives alert metadata only.
- Telephony/notifications: Twilio — only used for SMS notifications where customers opt in; no raw prompts transmitted by default.
- Code repo & CI: GitHub — stores build artifacts, limited logs; access controlled.

If you need a CSV column mapping or additional vendor contact details we can provide those in a follow up. For the SOC 2 summary and KMS attestation we have included the appropriate PDF stubs; if DataRidge requires full SOC 2 artifacts we can proceed under an NDA — I included the procurement link below for your team.

Proposed next steps:
- Please confirm receipt and tell us if the manifest granularity is sufficient.
- If helpful, we can schedule a 30min walkthrough next week to go over the dataflow diagram and KMS handling (Mina & Vivek will join).

Meeting availability: Tue 12/22 10:00–12:00 PT or Wed 12/23 14:00–16:00 PT.

Thanks,
Evelyn Hart
Director, Customer Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
